title: Best Budget Stays & Hostels in Maun
description: The best budget accommodation in Maun, Botswana — from iconic backpacker hostels to riverside lodges. Curated from real Reddit reviews and traveler tips. Includes prices, map, and honest verdicts.

redditQuotes.text: The backpackers has everything you need — friendly staff, comfortable beds, warm showers, a fully stocked bar, and a very decent kitchen. The views and atmosphere in the bar area are great.
I stayed at the Old Bridge Backpackers and it was great and lively. If you're on a budget, a campsite is your best bet. They also had a pizza oven which was great.

Audi Camp is situated on the banks of the Thamalakane River, 12 kms from the center of Maun. We have 4 en-suite luxury tents on raised wooden decking. Surrounded by water and great food, it's an old-school safari experience.
redditQuotes.source: — Audi Camp website · Audi Camp, Maun

redditQuotes.text: People were talking about Audi Camp as well. It's apparently great. Originally called Maun Rest Camp, this is now owned and managed by Old Bridge Backpackers across the river!

places.name: Maun Rest Camp
places.priceRange: 💴 100 (~$7) per person per night · P35 extra for power point

redditQuotes.text: We ended up staying here for two nights — P100 per person per night + P35 if you want to use the electric socket at the campsite. Great camping.
redditQuotes.source: — TripAdvisor review of Maun Rest Camp

redditQuotes.text: Nowadays you can find budget accommodation in Kasane and Maun. From there, you can use either a rented vehicle or a local tour operator. Botswana does not have to be as expensive as people think.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Botswana · Why is Botswana so expensive? (2025)

redditQuotes.text: Sitatunga campsite is well located close to Maun, but in a quiet area away from the town. You can upgrade for P40 per person per night to get a private ablutions block.
We have our biggest Sahara tents with a normal bed inside/Queen beds for P500 per tent per night. Family tent which can take 4 people also available.
redditQuotes.source: — Sitatunga Camp Facebook · Budget camping in Maun

redditQuotes.text: There are a few backpacker hostels in Maun that cater to budget travelers passing through on their way to the Delta. The Power Station is one of the more centrally located options.
redditQuotes.source: — Backpacker Hostels near Maun Airport guide

redditQuotes.text: If you're on a budget, a campsite is your best bet, but for those wanting a roof over their head, the Maun backpacker options are solid and reasonably priced.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Shoestring · Cheap Okavango Delta tours from Maun

places.name: Discovery Bed & Breakfast
places.address: Outskirts of Maun, traditional village setting

redditQuotes.text: Accommodation was clean, comfortable and very attractive. Set in a lovely garden and decorated in a charming Botswana theme. Dinner was excellent, featuring traditional dishes, and breakfast was delicious. Our hosts and their team were friendly, informative and efficient.
redditQuotes.source: — Booking.com verified review · Discovery Bed and Breakfast

redditQuotes.text: Just a wonderful place. The staff is amazing and the dinner was delicious. Highly recommend you stay here to start off your Botswana adventure.

places.name: Riley's Hotel (Cresta Riley's)
places.address: On the Thamalakane River, central Maun

redditQuotes.text: Cresta Riley's offers any visitor to Maun a warm welcome in true African style. Located on the banks of the Thamakalane River, it has free WiFi, free parking, and is convenient to Maun Gardens.
Compare prices and find the best deal for Cresta Riley's Hotel. Rates from $73. A historic property right in the center of Maun — the most central proper hotel option.
Nice hotel in Maun — good clean property with friendly staff. Food selection was great and quite tasty and good beer on tap too. Pool was well kept. It's reasonably priced.
redditQuotes.source: — Booking.com verified review · Sedia Hotel Maun

redditQuotes.text: Excellent and spacious hotel. Great service and food. Lovely pool. Only downside was cost of transfer from airport which was too expensive.

places.name: Maun Lodge
places.address: By the river, central Maun area

redditQuotes.text: Guests can take a refreshing dip in the sparkling outdoor pool, unwind with a rejuvenating massage at the spa, or savor delectable local and international cuisine at The Boma restaurant.
The average room rate for Island Safari Lodge in the past month is 948.26 BWP, while Maun Lodge offers competitive pricing — from $89 for a quality stay with pool access.

places.name: Crocodile Camp Safari & Spa
places.address: 12km from Maun toward Moremi Game Reserve

redditQuotes.text: Crocodile Camp Safari & Spa is located a 12-kilometre drive away from the small town of Maun, towards the Moremi Game Reserve. With accommodation for 60 lodging guests and 100 campers, it caters to every traveler's needs with African-styled comfort.
redditQuotes.source: — Crocodile Camp website · Crocodile Camp, Maun

redditQuotes.text: Book in Crocodile Camp Safari & Spa in Maun, Botswana. From $137 a night. 11.2 km from the city center. Great location for Moremi access.

places.name: Island Safari Lodge
places.address: 300-acre private island reserve, 10km from Maun Airport

redditQuotes.text: Island Safari Lodge is a great option for those staying in Maun to explore the Okavango Delta, Chief's Island, and Moremi. The property is in an absolutely gorgeous setting right on the River — very serene and beautiful.
redditQuotes.source: — Booking.com verified review · Island Safari Lodge

redditQuotes.text: Wonderful! 10 — Excellent overnight stop. 9.0 Wonderful overall. The lodge is in a stunning setting with incredible river access. Scores highest among mid-range Maun options.

places.name: Thamalakane River Lodge
places.address: Outside Maun, on the Thamalakane River

redditQuotes.text: The location of the lodge is terrific — out of town and right by the river. Great deck for watching the hippos and birdlife while working. The rooms were nice and the cooked-to-order breakfasts were excellent.
Absolutely good value for money, overwhelmingly friendly owners, great services, great chalets, nice food and stunning atmosphere. Full heartedly recommending.
redditQuotes.source: — Booking.com verified review · Thamalakane River Lodge

places.name: Royal Tree Lodge
places.address: 20 minutes from Maun, private Thamalakane River reserve

redditQuotes.text: Royal Tree Lodge is just 20 minutes from Maun, the gateway to the Okavango Delta. It's in a private reserve and is on the banks of the Thamalakane River. With garden views, the lodge has a restaurant, shared lounge, bar, garden, year-round outdoor pool and sun terrace.
redditQuotes.source: — Royal Tree Lodge · Royal Tree Lodge, Maun

redditQuotes.text: Royal Tree Lodge — 4-star hotel in Maun. The garden and private reserve setting make it feel genuinely remote, even though you're only 20 minutes from the airport.
